digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler Jira DC live harness
propositions: Bidirectional reconciliation against a realistic store copy must be proven live with both inbound (DC to local) and outbound (local to DC) data movement, not merely convergence on empty state
Store isolation requires a separate git repo with no remotes, explicit orphan-branch fetch, REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, and absence assertions on git remote and sync config
All reconciler binding and snapshot artifacts (.bridge_state*, bindings.json, prev_snapshot.json) must be scrubbed from the copied store via pattern matching and asserted absent
Every mutation mutation (create, edit, link, assign, parent, delete) in both directions must round-trip through oracles asserting the exact values written, never just zero exceptions
Pagination must be exercised through seeded issues exceeding the observed server page size, with full recovery asserted by mutation count
Three product defects were found and closed: sub-task parent immutability on DC (platform limitation), epic parent disjoint gates (fixed), and outbound CREATE-and-bind never binding (fixed)
